{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient, as per the data dictionary
# No filtering on biomarker_baseline is done, because the question is about enrolled patients, not valid biomarker data
deduplicated = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Final count of unique patients
n_patients = len(deduplicated)

# Print the result
print(n_patients)"}
